mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 84 degrees outside of Verona City Hall, with a full moon rising tonight.

The City Clerk's Office is excited to announce that community voting for the I Voted sticker design contest is now open. Students submitted 53 designs across four grade categories, and residents can cast their votes online or via paper ballot at City Hall through August 7 to help choose the winning stickers for the November election.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, you can check out trivia at either Hop Haus Brewing Company or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the downtown Farmer's Market returns to Hometown Junction Park, along with Wednesday pizza at Lake Lou-ee and trivia at the Bogey Factory.

In a report covering July 20 to July 27, the Verona Police Department noted that on July 26, a hit and run crash occurred near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, resulting in a citation for an 83-year-old driver.
Our flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, which is a perfect way to cool off since we are open until 10 PM. You can also visit the Kona Ice truck today at Fireman's Park from 1:30 PM to 4:15 PM.
